description: A content command centre in Svelte 5: one grid, two views. A Calendar and Board toggle renders the same posts as an editorial month where you drag a draft idea from the backlog onto a date, or as an approval pipeline of Idea, Draft, In review, Scheduled and Published where dragging a card between lanes changes its status. A left rail filters channels and lists campaigns and owners, a KPI strip counts scheduled, published and in review plus total reach, and every board card carries a seven-point engagement SvSparkline.

faq.question: How can the same grid be a calendar and a board?
faq.answer: The toggle switches between passing the scheduler prop and the board prop to one SvGrid over the same rows; a status change on the board or a date change on the calendar writes to the same row.

faq.question: Where does the engagement sparkline come from?
faq.answer: Each post carries a reach number and a trend array; the board card snippet renders an SvSparkline from the array in the channel's colour.

faq.question: How do channel filters apply to both views?
faq.answer: They filter the rows array before it reaches the grid, so hiding a channel removes its posts from the calendar and the pipeline at once.
